Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly get rid of muscle knots, spasms, and trigger points in the lower back.

All of these exercises work a differently (they're going to target different areas and muscles). To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

As a bonus, they can all be done at home, require no equipment, and may give relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and fix lower back muscle knots and spasms!
